subject.title: dotenv loader does not expand env references in .env files

question: Which dotenv sources, if any, should expand `$VAR` and `${VAR}` references, and how should OpenClaw handle missing referenced values?
rationale: The code change is mechanically bounded, but the choice controls credential propagation and lower-trust workspace dotenv semantics.

options.title: Approve Trusted-Source Expansion
options.body: Expand references only for trusted global/state-dir and legacy gateway dotenv sources after process-env precedence, keep workspace credential/control protections intact, and define missing refs before implementation.

options.title: Keep Dotenv Values Literal
options.body: Document `.env` values as literal and direct users to config substitution, SecretRefs, or shell import for aliasing.

options.title: Expand All Dotenv Sources
options.body: Allow project and global `.env` expansion with broader security tests and accept the larger workspace-trust review burden.

recommendation.title: Approve Trusted-Source Expansion
recommendation.body: Expand references only for trusted global/state-dir and legacy gateway dotenv sources after process-env precedence, keep workspace credential/control protections intact, and define missing refs before implementation.
